detail.longDescription: I migrated my home server from VMs to Docker a couple of days ago... resource usage is much lower. I was using about 40% CPU, 13GB of RAM and an unaccountable disk space (different now inaccessible virtual disks). Now, I'm at 14.5% CPU, 8GB of RAM and 24GB of disk storage. I didn't expect the CPU to go this low. # SelfHosting # Docker # Debian # Linux
